facts: day-ahead awards of ERCOT's storage fleet per MW, 2026-07: 681.53 USD/MW.
Over the 7 months held, 2026-01 to 2026-07, it ran from 446.38 (2026-02) to 2356.92 (2026-01) USD/MW.
